descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have pitching and execution experience? Have you Do you have experience in advisory and project management activities?

We are looking for an analyst who will be :

• Supporting senior product and coverage colleagues in developing debt solutions for clients, particularly via bond buybacks and bond amendments
• Assisting with preparing client materials with input from senior product bankers
• Supporting deal execution by producing marketing materials, reviewing deal documentation, and adhering to internal Global Banking deal protocols
• Tracking and maintaining deal libraries and knowledge repositories of the desk
• Gradually take on a more independent role in deal executions; gradually take ownership of specific client situations
• Generating trade ideas for the desk
